import re
src = open('algo.py').read()
# temporary instrumentation: number each failure point
lines = src.split('\n')
out = []
cnt = [0]
inaudit = False
for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
    if ln.startswith('def _audit'):
        inaudit = True
    elif ln.startswith('def ') and inaudit:
        inaudit = False
    if inaudit and re.match(r'^\s+return False\s*$', ln) or inaudit and re.match(r'^\s+return (False)\n', ln):
        cnt[0] += 1
        indent = re.match(r'^\s+', ln).group(0)
        out.append(f"{indent}print('FAILPOINT {cnt[0]} at line {i+1}', flush=True)")
    out.append(ln)
open('algo_dbg.py','w').write('\n'.join(out))
print('instrumented', cnt[0], 'points')
PYEOF
